meta.name: {community} Rules and Regulations
meta.notice: Section 0 and Section 1 apply to the Discord and to the {game}. Section A applies to in-game conduct on the lifesteal server.
meta.philosophy: The goal is a fair and consistent moderation system that holds wrongdoers accountable while leaving the survival gameplay itself unrestricted. Stealing, raiding, griefing, trapping and betrayal are core lifesteal mechanics and are never punishable. Rules exist to protect people, not inventories.
meta.appeals: Every ban may be appealed in the appeal server. A permanent ban is the end of an escalation ladder, not the starting point, and it remains appealable. Rule 0.5 is the sole exception and is never lifted.

sections.title: How and Where We Moderate
sections.summary: Scope of moderation and the exceptions to it
sections.description:
Moderation covers every public Discord channel and the {game}, including in-game chat, signs, books, item names and builds. Private direct messages are not moderated by default, with the following exceptions, which are actioned wherever they occur: slurs used to harass, harassment or bullying of any kind, hacking or the theft of personal data, threats, scamming for real money, and any form of pedophilia or sexual harassment.

Staff reserve the right to moderate outside these guidelines where it is necessary to keep the community safe. Punishments listed in this document are the standard outcome; staff may escalate where severity clearly warrants it, and every escalation is recorded on the case.

sections.title: Racism
sections.summary: Racially charged language
sections.description: It is completely unacceptable to use language that is racially charged, which includes slurs and offensive terminology, in Discord or in game.

clauses.title: Discriminatory or stereotypical language based on race, excluding slurs
Using racial slurs
clauses.note: Context is not taken into consideration.

clauses.title: Sharing media, builds or signs containing racist or discriminatory content
clauses.note: Context is taken into consideration.

sections.title: Homophobia and Transphobia
sections.summary: Language and content meant to belittle LGBTQ+ members
sections.description: This community firmly opposes any behaviour that harms members of the LGBTQ+ community.

clauses.title: Using hateful language towards the LGBTQ+ community
clauses.note: If it is not directed at anyone, a warning is issued first. If the warning is ignored or argued, follow the standard progression.

clauses.title: Using a profile, username or skin to represent homophobic concepts
clauses.note: The member is asked to remove the content first. This punishment applies on refusal.

clauses.title: Using slurs typically used to target the LGBTQ+ community
Sharing anti LGBTQ+ media
Using vocabulary that can be interpreted as homophobic
clauses.note: For example using a sexuality as an insult or to convey negativity.

sections.title: NSFW
sections.summary: Posting or promoting content that is inappropriate
sections.description: The promotion of content that is not safe for work is not permitted in Discord, in chat, in books, on signs, or in builds.

clauses.title: Minor NSFW solicitation, such as suggestive content with no nudity or innuendo
Medium NSFW solicitation, such as partial nudity, excessive targeted profanity or mild violence
Major NSFW solicitation, such as explicit content, full nudity, sexual acts or graphic violence
Building, naming or decorating anything in game to depict NSFW content
clauses.note: The build is removed. The member is asked to take it down first where the content is borderline.

clauses.title: Using a profile picture, bio, name, nickname or skin to promote NSFW media
clauses.note: The member is asked to remove the content first. This punishment applies on refusal.

sections.title: Harassment
sections.summary: Bullying and relentlessly bothering people without their consent
sections.description: Cyber bullying and targeted aggression cause lasting harm. There is zero tolerance for it. Note that in game hostility such as being raided, killed or robbed is not harassment.

clauses.title: Cyber bullying or targeted aggression that causes harm, in private messages or public chats
Repeatedly voicing negative opinions towards an individual beyond playful banter
clauses.note: Members who are consistently involved in disputes receive escalating mutes and, given the severity, bans.

clauses.title: Mocking someone over traumatic events or significant historical tragedies
Sexual harassment
clauses.note: Threatening rape in any context is an immediate permanent ban regardless of offense count.

clauses.title: Casual use of the word rape as gamer vocabulary
Spam pinging, or pinging people without their permission
Encouraging or suggesting self harm, suicide or related behaviour
Targeted in game stalking used solely to drive a member off the server
clauses.note: Raiding, killing and stealing are permitted. This clause covers relentless targeting paired with harassment in chat, after the victim has asked staff for help.

sections.title: Pedophilia
sections.summary: Grooming or inappropriate conduct between an adult and a minor
sections.description: There is a zero tolerance policy towards pedophilia in a community where younger players interact with adults.

clauses.title: Any conduct falling under this rule

sections.title: Anti Religious Conduct
sections.summary: Being ignorant or disrespectful towards religion
sections.description: This community holds a position of religious neutrality. Atheism and spirituality are included under the term religion.

clauses.title: Engaging in debates about religion or the existence of a deity
clauses.note: All parties involved receive the punishment.

clauses.title: Mocking religion or treating religious belief as frivolous or unintelligent
Discriminating against individuals of Jewish heritage

sections.title: Sexism
sections.summary: Reinforcing gender stereotypes or claiming one gender is superior
sections.description: This community values and respects members of all genders.

clauses.title: Promoting and upholding sexist ideals
Endorsing or spreading media that reinforces sexist ideologies

sections.title: Politics
sections.summary: Disrespectful discussion of political views
sections.description: Civil political discussion is tolerated, but discussions that breach the respect and courtesy standards are ended by staff.

clauses.title: Expressing support for abhorrent political figures or regimes
Disrespect or ridicule towards individuals based on their political views

sections.title: Ableism
sections.summary: Discriminating against disabled people
sections.description: Ableism is under recognised, so awareness is raised first where appropriate. Attempts to exploit that leniency to spread hate are not tolerated.

clauses.title: Mocking disabilities
Indirectly employing ableist slurs
clauses.note: Neutral, technical or historical usage that clearly and solely means delayed or slowed, or that forms part of a genuine clinical or archival quotation, is not punished, provided the context cannot reasonably be read as a slur.

clauses.title: Directly employing ableist slurs
Spreading ableist content

sections.title: Hacking and Personal Data
sections.summary: Violating the privacy of others
sections.description: There is zero tolerance for malicious cyber activity such as hacking, identity theft, or the unauthorised handling of personal information. This rule concerns real people, not in game accounts or inventories.

clauses.title: Unauthorised disclosure or acquisition of an individual's personal information
clauses.note: Staff investigate the situation fully before the punishment is applied.

clauses.title: Using an individual's personal information to blackmail them
Impersonating another member's profile, username or skin
clauses.note: The member is asked to change their profile first. This punishment applies on refusal and is lifted once the profile is changed.

clauses.title: Faking evidence as a form of defamation
clauses.note: The faker receives the punishment that their false report would have carried for the accused.

clauses.title: Scamming a member out of real money, accounts, or anything of real world value
clauses.note: In game scamming for in game items is permitted and is not covered by this clause.

clauses.title: Attacking the server or its infrastructure, including denial of service attacks

sections.title: Server Sabotage
sections.summary: Deliberately undermining the server itself rather than playing on it
sections.description: Fair play protects the server as a service. Attacks on the health of the server, as opposed to attacks on other players, are treated seriously.

clauses.title: Reporting staff bias in bad faith, or making repeated knowingly false reports
Organising a coordinated effort to drive players off the server or to shut it down
Recruiting for or advertising a competing server inside {community}
Leaking staff discussions, moderation records, or internal channels

sections.title: Cheating
sections.summary: Using unauthorised methods to gain an advantage
sections.description:
Lifesteal is built on risk. Cheating removes that risk and is the most damaging thing a player can do to the server.

Allowed client modifications: Fabric and Forge performance mods such as Sodium, Lithium, Iris and OptiFine; visual mods that do not reveal hidden information; minimaps with cave mapping and entity radar disabled; Litematica in printer disabled mode; Inventory Tweaks and similar quality of life mods.

Prohibited at all times: X-ray of any kind, including texture packs and shaders that reveal ores; kill aura, aimbot, reach, velocity and anti knockback; auto totem, auto clicker and macros that automate combat; flight, speed, no fall, jesus and other movement hacks; freecam; entity or player radar; scaffold; nuker and fast break; any ghost client.

clauses.title: Using a combat cheat such as kill aura, aimbot, reach, velocity or anti knockback
Using X-ray, a cave finder, or any method of revealing hidden blocks
Using movement cheats such as flight, speed, no fall or jesus
Using auto totem, auto clicker, or a macro that automates combat or clicking
Using freecam, entity radar, or any other information cheat
Using a VPN or proxy to evade a ban or to disguise an alternate account
Distributing cheat clients, or teaching others how to break any clause of this rule
Misrepresenting your client, mods or hardware, or evading staff questions about them
Allowing a known cheater to use your account, or playing on an account that is not yours

sections.title: Self Promotion and Advertising
sections.summary: Using the community to advertise something
sections.description: Promotion of pre approved communities is allowed in the designated channels. Everything else requires staff approval first.

clauses.title: Advertising an unaffiliated server or community, in channels or by direct message
Promoting content outside the designated channels

sections.title: Improper Chat Behaviour
sections.summary: Abusing chat to disrupt the flow of conversation
sections.description: Chat is shared space. Swearing is allowed. Excessive swearing, spam and disruption are not.

clauses.title: Spamming, including copypasta, text walls and repeated messages
Excessive profanity, meaning profanity used at volume or aimed at a person
clauses.note: Ordinary swearing is permitted. This clause is for saturation or targeting.

clauses.title: Bypassing the chat filter with spacing, symbols or deliberate misspelling
Posting unsolicited links, invites, or file downloads

sections.title: Cooperation with Staff
sections.summary: Working with the staff team rather than against it
sections.description: Staff decisions can be questioned in a ticket. They cannot be fought in public channels.

clauses.title: Hostility towards staff members, including in response to a staff decision
Refusing to comply with a reasonable staff instruction or investigation
Impersonating a staff member, or claiming staff authority you do not hold
Opening false, joke or empty tickets, or abusing the ticket system

sections.title: Enabling and Supporting Banned Members
sections.summary: Keeping banned members properly isolated
sections.description: A ban means nothing if the community carries the banned member anyway. These rules install consequences for supporting them.

clauses.title: Allowing a banned player to play on the server through your account or with your help
Assisting ban evasion, or failing to report an alternate account you know about
Defending or justifying the actions of banned players in public channels
clauses.note: Bans may be discussed in a ticket.

clauses.title: Evading a ban or a mute yourself, on any account

sections.title: Voice Chat
sections.summary: All server rules apply in voice
sections.description: Every rule in this document applies in voice channels and in proximity voice chat.

clauses.title: Using a voice changer to disrupt or deceive
Disrupting voice with loud soundboards, mic spam or ear rape
Starting or escalating an argument in voice
clauses.note: Minor is one day, medium is one week, major is one month. Staff select the offense level that fits.

clauses.title: Encouraging an argument in voice

sections.title: Permitted Gameplay
sections.summary: What lifesteal allows, stated plainly
sections.description:
{community} is a lifesteal server. The following are core mechanics and are never punishable, no matter how upset the victim is:

Stealing from chests, enderchests, shulkers and dropped items. Raiding and griefing any player base, including full destruction. Killing any player, anywhere, at any time, including on sight and while they are unprepared. Taking hearts through combat and leaving a player on their last life. Trapping players with lava, TNT, pistons, portals or falling blocks. Betraying allies, breaking deals, and scamming other players out of in game items. Spawn killing outside the protected spawn radius. Baiting, luring and setting up ambushes. Claiming, hoarding or blocking access to natural resources.

Do not open a ticket to report any of the above. Reports about permitted gameplay are closed and may be actioned under rule 1.5 clause D.

sections.title: Exploits and Duplication
sections.summary: Bugs that break the economy
sections.description: Survival mechanics are fair game. Bugs that create items or hearts from nothing are not. Report any exploit you find in a support ticket; reporting an exploit in good faith is never punished.

clauses.title: Duplicating items, blocks or hearts through any bug or exploit
Distributing a duplication or exploit method to other players
Knowingly using duplicated items after being told to hand them in
Leaving the world border, entering unloaded terrain, or using a coordinate exploit
Abusing a plugin or command bug, including combat logging to escape a fight

sections.title: Server Performance
sections.summary: Keeping the server playable for everyone
sections.description: Redstone and farms are encouraged. Machines built to degrade server performance are not.

clauses.title: Building a lag machine, or any contraption designed to harm server performance
Running an unattended farm that measurably degrades tick rate after a staff warning
clauses.note: Staff ask for the farm to be switched off or rebuilt first.

clauses.title: Crash exploits, packet spam, or anything that disconnects other players
Excessive entity or item stacking used to crash chunks

sections.title: Alternate Accounts and Heart Farming
sections.summary: One player, one set of hearts
sections.description: Lifesteal only works when hearts are won from real opponents. Manufacturing hearts from accounts you control defeats the entire mode.

clauses.title: Farming hearts from an alternate account you own or control
Arranging heart trading, where players kill each other on purpose to transfer hearts
Running an undeclared alternate account on the server
clauses.note: Alternate accounts must be declared to staff in a ticket before they join.

clauses.title: Using an alternate account to hold items or hearts for a banned player

sections.title: Builds, Signs and Chat Content
sections.summary: In game content is held to the same standard as Discord
sections.description: Anything you write or build in game is public content. Sections 0.1 through 0.9 apply to signs, books, item names, banners, pixel art and terrain edits.

clauses.title: Building, writing or naming anything that breaks a Section 0 rule
clauses.note: The punishment from the Section 0 rule that was broken applies in addition to this case.

clauses.title: Building offensive imagery in a public or high traffic area

sections.title: Spawn and Protected Areas
sections.summary: The only places on the map where the normal rules do not apply
sections.description: Griefing and killing are permitted everywhere except the protected spawn region, official event arenas while an event is running, and any area staff have marked as protected. Those areas exist so new players have somewhere to stand.

clauses.title: Killing players inside the protected spawn radius
Trapping, walling or camping the spawn exit to farm players leaving spawn
Griefing spawn, an event arena, or a staff protected build
Disrupting an official event, including killing participants outside the event rules

sections.title: Real World Trading
sections.summary: In game value stays in game
sections.description: Trading, scamming and stealing inside the game are permitted. Bringing real money, accounts or external goods into it is not, because staff cannot moderate it and it makes real victims.

clauses.title: Buying or selling in game items, hearts or ranks for real money
Scamming a member out of real money, gift cards or accounts
clauses.note: This is also a breach of rule 1.0 clause E.

clauses.title: Trading in game items for services or goods outside the server

sections.title: Griefing the Server Itself
sections.summary: The line between raiding a player and attacking the server
sections.description: Destroying another player's base is gameplay. Destroying shared infrastructure that the whole server depends on is not.

clauses.title: Destroying shared infrastructure such as public nether highways, portals or spawn shops
Deliberately destroying world features the server relies on, such as the end fight or a stronghold portal

sections.title: Reporting and Evidence
sections.summary: How reports are judged
sections.description: Reports are decided on evidence. Uncropped, unedited video is the standard. Screenshots are accepted only for chat offences, and only when the sender and the timestamp are visible.

clauses.title: Submitting cropped, edited or fabricated evidence
clauses.note: Fabricated evidence is handled under rule 1.0 clause D instead, which carries the accused player's punishment.

clauses.title: Reporting permitted gameplay as a rule break after being told it is allowed
